accessibilityChecks: route navigation exposes aria-current on active page
loading and action status use aria-live regions
icon-only reload control has an aria-label
textareas and free-text inputs have programmatic labels
reference type select has a programmatic label
selection and version controls expose pressed/current state
upload and billing edge errors use role alert
support route exposes privacy and AI content responsibility notices
unitCoverage: auth/session state is loaded from the persisted dev workspace
account settings persist through workspace reload
candidate selection, workspace autosave, canvas versions, and package history survive reload
reference upload validation accepts safe images/documents/HTTPS URLs and rejects unsupported inputs
report-problem tickets retain project, export, task, trace, asset, and quota context
blocked exports do not consume quota and mock checkout activates the local alpha plan
inactive, past_due, and quota-exhausted billing states block quota-consuming exports
